queries: Zitron "$22 billion" compute spend outside OpenAI Anthropic
analysts estimate 70% hyperscaler AI revenue from OpenAI and Anthropic 2026

sources_considered.why: A summary of the speaker's own writing. It cannot serve as evidence that he was right.
The speaker's own writing. Excluded as evidence.
Its related links mention Microsoft revenue from OpenAI. That is one vendor's figure and does not measure global non-OpenAI/Anthropic spending.

unresolved_gaps: No public source measures global AI compute spending outside OpenAI and Anthropic.
Hyperscalers do not break out AI revenue by customer. Analyst share estimates differ widely (for AWS, about 3% to 13% for the two labs, per search summaries).
The claim gives no period or basis. Choosing one, such as the latest quarter or an annualized figure, would be the evaluator's choice and could decide the result.
